description: This file defines the 'RequestResponse' class in the Slim Framework, implementing an invocation strategy for route callbacks that passes the request, response, and route parameters.

classes.name: RequestResponse
classes.description: Implements a route invocation strategy that passes request, response, and route parameters as arguments to the route callback.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes a route callable with the given request, response, and route arguments, attaching route parameters as request attributes.
